verdict.rationale: Per-user or tenant-scoped search is a fair axis for a search engine, but nothing in the evidence pack describes scoped API keys, tenant tokens, or embedded filters that limit each end user to their own documents. The only related items are a bare 'Security' heading in the production best-practices page and generic 'Filtering results' and 'Personalized Search with JOINs' headings. None of these shows a token-based mechanism for restricting searches without separate per-user indexes.
